items.question: Which textual division formally concludes the preceding meditative instructions?
premises: The term paṭalaḥ denotes a chapter or section.
It functions as a structural marker in the text.
The preceding verses present meditative instructions.
items.inference: This term marks the formal conclusion of the current chapter.
uncertainties: The specific chapter number or title is not indicated in this token.
